leadText:
Pokémon Master Journeys: The Series is the twenty-fourth season of the dubbed version of the Pokémon animated series. It is the second season of Pokémon Journeys: The Series. The season follows and Goh as they continue traveling around the , with Ash facing stronger and stronger opponents on his quest to climb to the top of the Pokémon World Coronation Series rankings.

In , episodes were added quarterly on Netflix, beginning on September 10, 2021 with the first twelve episodes, starting from To Train, or Not to Train! and concluding on May 26, 2022 with the last fifteen episodes, ending with Showdown at the Gates of Warp!. In , it debuted on June 12, 2021 on Teletoon. In , it debuted on August 3, 2021 on . In , it debuted on September 1, 2021 on .

It is preceded by Pokémon Journeys: The Series, and succeeded by Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series.

==Blurb==
 It’s a big, big world, but you know where to find Ash and Goh—battling and catching Pokémon from Kanto to Galar! With Pikachu, Cinderace, and their other Pokémon beside them, our heroes continue to travel all over the world to research Pokémon for Cerise Laboratory. Along the way, Ash climbs higher in the World Coronation Series rankings, and Goh adds more Pokémon to his Pokédex in his quest to catch Mew. Meanwhile, Chloe takes her first steps as a Pokémon Trainer when she meets a mysterious Eevee. New friends, returning rivals, and exciting adventures await—as the journey continues!
